blocks.value: Liquidity tells us how easily a stock can be bought or sold without causing a significant change in its price.
Imagine This: Selling a popular smartphone is usually easy because many buyers exist. Selling an old rare machine may take weeks because very few people want it. Stocks behave similarly.
Highly liquid stocks have many buyers and sellers. Illiquid stocks may take longer to buy or sell and can experience larger price changes.
Large companies like Reliance and Infosys are generally highly liquid because millions of shares are traded daily.
High liquidity usually means easier trading and smaller differences between Bid and Ask prices.
